content:
sara: Heads-up — OnyxBank kickoff in 30m. They want a 48h POC to prove parity with their current vendor. Key asks: request/response shape identical, no token billing surprises, and security questionnaire answered.

alex: Thanks. We'll run the compat proxy and map endpoints. Main gap is header names (their vendor uses X-Client-Id + Authorization Bearer). I can add automatic header adapters.

micah: For parity testing I suggest: 1) run 2k seed prompts through both endpoints, 2) compute token delta and response diffs, 3) flag >10% semantic variance. I can start the job on Dedicated if we reserve a small pool. ETA 24h to prep.

jordan: Product note — our model catalog has a few variants that behave differently on summarization. Recommend pin to model v2.1-compat for the POC; include explicit prompt templates to reduce hallucination. Also call out that our tokenizer may split some legal tokens differently.

eva: Security: OnyxBank requires IP allowlist + Azure AD SAML. They also asked for KMS wrap for logs. We'll need their SP metadata and a completed security questionnaire before we spin up Private/Dedicated. I added a checklist in the shared drive.

beth: Legal: They want a POC addendum limiting retention to 30 days and no secondary use. We need to confirm we can enforce that on Hosted vs Dedicated. Also confirm no PHI will be sent.

sara: Action items: @alex header adapter + demo proxy; @micah run diff job; @eva send SAML request; @beth draft addendum. Onyx contact: emma@onyxbank.com.

micah: Quick curl proxy example I'm going to use for smoke (replace API_KEY):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.dev/onyx/generate
  -H "X-Client-Id: onyx-poc"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0}'
```

The proxy rewrites to our internal /v1/generate and preserves their response schema: {"id","choices":[{"text"}],"meta"}.

alex: Pricing Q from Onyx: will token billing be 1:1 with their vendor? Short answer: usually no — tokenization differs. For the POC we can offer a flat trial credit and provide post-POC reconciliation. If they need exact billing parity we should run an invoiceable smoke to measure token multiplier.

eva: Also note: if we run Dedicated in their VPC, we can guarantee no logging to external buckets. For Hosted, we can enable customer-managed KMS to encrypt persisted logs. Need their KMS ARN.

beth: Legal redline: add clause that POC traffic is excluded from data mining and will be purged within 30 days. Can someone confirm purge endpoint/flow?

micah: I can add an automated purge job tied to the POC tag. Will provide a short runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch: onyx/compat-proxy-demo — build 1573 — ETA ~6m :rocket:

sara: Two blockers right now: 1) Onyx's security team paused on the questionnaire (they want our SOC2 subreport), 2) network ops need the egress IPs for their firewall. @eva can you surface SOC2 addendum and we should share the IP CIDRs.

eva: Uploaded SOC2 SOC-report-redwood.pdf to the drive and sent it to emma. Netops IPs: 52.23.112.0/24, 34.120.9.0/24. Sending to their infra now.

alex: After the proxy smoke I’ll demo parity screen capture and a short note on expected diffs (token multiplier, slight phrasing differences). Will ask Onyx if they want deterministic mode (temp=0) for stricter parity.

sara: Great. We'll aim to have the POC ready and security Q answered within 48h. If legal or security blocks persist, escalate to account exec. :thumbsup:
